task: Fix Back to My Capstone redirect bounce loop and upgrade broken progress bar UI into connected milestone pipeline

rootCauses.issue: Infinite Redirect Loop on Back to My Capstone button
rootCauses.cause: TitleApprovalPage navigated to /project without query params. In MyProjectPage, a useEffect unconditionally redirected any project with titleStatus !== 'approved' to /project/approval, immediately bouncing the student back.
rootCauses.resolution: Updated TitleApprovalPage button to navigate('/project?view=overview'). Updated MyProjectPage redirect guard to verify searchParams.get('view') !== 'overview' and !searchParams.get('tab'). Exposed Title Proposals & Approval Studio button on MyProjectPage unconditionally.

rootCauses.issue: Broken Progress Bar UI on TitleApprovalPage
rootCauses.cause: Milestone progression was rendered as 4 disjointed static grid boxes with no progress bar track, no completion percentage, and no connected step pipeline.
rootCauses.resolution: Replaced disjointed grid with a unified Title Defense & Approval Pipeline card featuring a dynamic stage pill, dynamic progress percentage (e.g. 75% Completed), continuous connected gradient progress track line with milestone ticks, and 4 interconnected milestone cards with Completed, In Progress, and Pending badges.

evidence.playwrightVisualAudit: Verified desktop (1440x900), mobile (390x844), light/dark modes, 125% zoom, and back-and-forth navigation without bounce
